name: The Hero Spotlight
source:
Natalie is a redheaded heroine on a four-person team. Cyan suit, no cape. Quietly competent. Until a routine fight goes long, and something in the air leaves her body running hot.

By the next morning, her suit is tighter. By the end of the week, she’s outgrowing it on camera. Her teammates notice. Adam, the team lead and the one who’s been quietly watching her for months, notices first. Jax pretends not to. Mira files a report.

Whatever’s happening to her isn’t stopping. The suit can be re-tailored. The press can be managed. What Natalie is supposed to do with the way Adam is looking at her now. That’s the part nobody wrote a protocol for.

A four-episode arc about a heroine that want's every eye in Manhattan to notice her.

[From [url=https://watermelon-universe.itch.io/the-hero-spotlight]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
娜塔莉是四人小队中的红发女主角。青色套装，没有斗篷。安静能干。直到一场例行的战斗持续很长时间，空气中的某种东西让她的身体变得发热。

到了第二天早上，她的衣服就更紧了。到了本周末，她在镜头前的表现就已经超出了她​​的标准。她的队友注意到了。亚当是团队负责人，也是几个月来一直默默观察她的人，他首先注意到了这一点。贾克斯假装不这么做。米拉提交报告。

无论发生在她身上的事情都不会停止。西装可以重新剪裁。新闻界是可以管理的。娜塔莉应该如何对待亚当现在看她的方式。这是没有人为其编写协议的部分。

这部四集故事讲述了一位女主角希望曼哈顿的每一双眼睛都注意到她的故事。

[来自[url=https://watermelon-universe.itch.io/the-hero-spotlight]itch.io[/url]]
